subject: addint used without prior scantwo evaluation of interactions

messages.author: 2dd32f61477027b2
messages.subject: addint used without prior scantwo evaluation of interactions
parts:
Hello Karl,
I am wondering if it is correct to run fitqtl in a completely additive manner (e.g. Q1+Q2+Q3+Q4) and than use addint (with the same formula than fitqtl of course) to evaluate possible interactions, in absence of scantwo evidences (I mean, without running scantwo).

That is due by the fact I cannot efficiently run scantwo, having too many markers. I know that there are workarounds, but first I would try to circumvent this problem using the multiple qtl approach weapons.

Many thanks in advance,
Emidio
